<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates: 2026-11-04

### ⬇️ Price cuts (~25% off)
- 🧠 Text: GPT-6.1 Sol · GPT-6 Luna · GPT-6 Sol · GPT-6 Astra

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🧠 Text: Claude Opus 5.5 (~35%) · Claude Fable 5.1 (~35%) · GPT-5.6 Sol (~125%)

### ✨ API updates
- Video models in this diff added `/video/{prompt}`. Those that previously listed `/v1/images/edits` no longer list it.
- The four changed 3D models now list `/3d/{prompt}` instead of their image endpoints.
- `x-ai/grok-4.7` no longer lists `logprobs` or `top_logprobs` as supported parameters. `moonshotai/kimi-k3` also lists fewer supported parameters. Check the docs before sending optional parameters.

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
